DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベンチの帽子です。風で落ちそうだったので持ちましたが、別の場所へ置くと持ち主が困りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った帽子を別置場へ移す懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A hat on a bench. I picked it up because the wind might blow it off, but moving it somewhere else may make things difficult for its owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about moving the hat you found to another place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池に近い二つ目のベンチです。帽子はまだ私が持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ位置と手元保管を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second bench near the pond. I still have the hat with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the bench's location and that you are holding the hat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理の受付へ渡せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can hand it in at the management reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、受付へ届けます。どこで見つけたかも一緒に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付へ渡し発見場所も伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will take it there. I would also like to tell them where I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand it to reception and explain where you found it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つけた時刻は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you remember when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。隣に人はいませんでしたが、誰の帽子かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見時刻と持主不明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten minutes ago. There was nobody beside it, but I do not know whose hat it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report when you found it and that the owner is unknown. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で場所と時刻をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell reception the place and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。近くの別ベンチへ勝手に置かず、届けた場所を記録しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勝手に置き直さず届先を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not leave it on another nearby bench without permission. I will note where I handed it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not move it to another place on your own; record where you handed it in. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 管理受付は入口の横です。帽子をそのまま持って、お届けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Management reception is next to the entrance. Please take the hat there as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 往復で買って二枚あります。行きにどちらを使うのか見分けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復二枚の使い分けを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought a round trip and have two tickets. I cannot tell which one to use for the outward journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to use the two round-trip tickets separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印字された区間を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the printed travel sections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらは今いる駅から目的地、もう一枚は逆の区間です。買った順に重ねたままでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各区間を読み重ねた状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is from our current station to the destination, and the other is the reverse. I had kept them stacked in purchase order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read each travel section and explain how the tickets were stacked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は行きの券を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today you use the outward ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き用を手元、帰り用を財布の別の所へ入れます。二枚同時に使うのではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き券と帰り券を別収納し同時使用を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will keep the outward ticket ready and put the return ticket in another part of my wallet. I do not use both together, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Store the outward and return tickets separately and avoid using them together. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。目的地はこの区間で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Is your destination right for this travel section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合っています。帰りの券もなくさないよう、降りた後に残っているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目的地一致と帰り券保管確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. To avoid losing the return ticket, I will check that I still have it after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the destination and that you will check you still have the return ticket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で予定を変える場合は、区間もご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your plans change along the way, ask us about the ticket section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は券の区間どおり移動し、変更があれば先に係へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区間変更時は係へ事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I will follow the section on my ticket, and ask staff first if anything changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult staff before changing the travel section. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行きの券はこちらです。区間を確認して改札へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is your outward ticket. Check the section and proceed to the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。携帯から印刷したら、全体が小さくなりました。この用紙で書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 縮小印刷した申請用紙の使用可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I printed it from my phone, the whole thing became small. May I fill in this version?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the reduced-size application form can be used. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文字と欄を確認します。二ページ分が一枚になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the text and fields. Two pages have been printed on one sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 印刷設定を間違えたようです。小さい欄へ無理に書いて読めなくするのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二頁一枚の設定ミスと読みにくさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I seem to have used the wrong print settings. I want to avoid squeezing writing into small fields and making it unreadable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two-pages-per-sheet setting mistake and the difficulty reading it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通常の大きさの用紙を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check a normal-size form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。記入済みの名前はありますが、その一か所だけで提出完了とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一部記入だけで提出済みと思わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I have already written my name, but I do not think filling that one field means the submission is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that completing only one part does not mean the form has been submitted. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要なページは両方ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have both required pages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内容は二ページあります。書き直す時に、片方を忘れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両頁内容ありで書直し漏れを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The content covers two pages. I will be careful not to miss either when writing it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that both pages are present and you will avoid omissions when rewriting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの用紙をご利用ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二ページを順番に書き、元の小さい用紙は提出用と混ぜないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通常用紙を順に記入し旧縮小版と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will fill in both pages in order and keep the old small form separate so it is not mixed with the ones for submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Complete the normal-size forms in order and separate them from the old reduced version. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通常の大きさで二ページお渡ししました。記入後に欄をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have given you two normal-size pages. Check the fields after completing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのような症状ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What symptoms are you experiencing today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察を受けるのは母です。私は日本語の説明を手伝うために付き添っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 患者は母で本人は言語補助と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother is the patient. I am accompanying her to help with explanations in Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother is the patient and you are providing language assistance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お母様のお名前を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your mother's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母の資料はこちらです。私の診察券では受付しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母の資料を提示し自分の券で登録しないと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are her documents. Please do not register her using my patient card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present your mother's documents and ask that your own card not be used for registration. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様ご本人から症状を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can we hear the symptoms from your mother herself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。母が話す内容を私が補助します。私の推測を本人の症状として加えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母の発話を補助し推測を加えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will help convey what she says. I will avoid adding my own guesses as if they were her symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will assist your mother's speech without adding guesses. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察への同席を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to be present for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が希望しています。ただ、本人だけで話したい時は私が外で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人希望の同席と単独相談時の退出を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mother would like that. But if she wants to speak alone, I will wait outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that she wants you present but you will leave if she wishes to speak privately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the medical staff about that preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。母の受付と付き添いの役割を分けて、問診票も母の情報で書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母の情報で問診票を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish my mother's registration from my role as her companion, and fill in the questionnaire with her information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Complete the medical questionnaire with your mother's information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お母様の資料で受付を確認します。同席の希望も診察担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check registration using your mother's documents and tell the clinician about her wish to have you present.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布をなくされたのですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここで届け出れば、中の銀行カードも全部止まるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布届出でカードも停止するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I report it here, will all the bank cards inside be blocked too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether reporting the wallet also blocks the cards. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの利用停止は、各発行元への連絡も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: For blocking the cards, please also check how to contact each issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。財布の届出とカードの停止を同じ手続きだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届出と発行元の停止を区別して理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I thought reporting the wallet and blocking the cards were the same procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the distinction between reporting the loss and having issuers block the cards. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中に入っていた物を整理できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you list what was inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀行カード二枚と診察券です。カード番号を全部覚えていませんが、発行元は分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード類の数と発行元情報を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two bank cards and a patient card. I do not remember all the card numbers, but I know the issuers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the number of cards and the issuer information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 各発行元の案内で、必要な確認をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow each issuer's instructions for the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ここでは財布の特徴と最後に使った場所を伝え、別に発行元へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布情報の届出と発行元連絡を別に行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Here I will describe the wallet and where I last used it, and contact the issuers separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the wallet's details and contact issuers separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give me your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。届けた後もカードの停止確認を忘れず、済んだ先をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を提示し停止確認済み先を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This number. After reporting, I will remember to confirm the card blocks and note which issuers I have finished contacting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your contact number and record the issuers with confirmed blocks. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 財布の届出を受け付けます。カードについては発行元への連絡状況も整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your wallet report. Please also organize your progress in contacting the card issuers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒を送られますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも添付書類を全部入れたか自信がありません。まだ封は閉じていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未封緘で添付漏れ不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I am not certain I included all the attachments. I have not sealed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unsealed and you worry about missing attachments. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで中身の必要枚数までは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine how many documents you need inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。提出先の一覧を使って、自分で入れた物を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先一覧で本人が確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will use the receiving organization's list to check what I put in myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check personally against the receiver's list. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる机をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can show you a desk for checking them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。順番に並べ、原本かコピーかも一覧と照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 机利用と原本コピーの照合を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I want to lay them out in order and check against the list whether each should be an original or a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use a desk and compare originals and copies with the list. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料金の確認は、そのあとでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is it all right to check the postage afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。入れる枚数が変わるかもしれないので、内容が決まってから重さを量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容確定後の計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The number of sheets might change, so please weigh it after the contents are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for weighing after the contents are finalized. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの机をお使いください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認して封を閉じてから、発送方法の相談へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照合封緘後に発送相談へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once I have checked and sealed it, I will return to ask about shipping methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return for shipping advice after checking and sealing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容の確認後に窓口へお持ちください。確定した重さでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring it to the counter once you have checked the contents. We will advise you based on the final weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名義の表示についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about how the account holder's name is displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前が長く、控えでは後半が見えません。登録名まで短くなっているのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの長い名の後半欠落を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is long, and the latter part is missing from the slip. I worry that the registered name has also been shortened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the missing latter part of your long name on the slip. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの表示と登録情報を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member in charge will check the slip's display and registered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。印刷に全部出ていないだけなのか、登録が違うのかを分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印刷表示と登録名の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I want to know separately whether it simply did not all print or the registration itself is wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the printed display and registered name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の名前が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a document showing your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードです。省略した名前で別口座を作りたいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人資料を提示し別名口座希望でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My residence card. I am not asking to open another account under an abbreviated name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present your identity document and explain that you do not want an account under another name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの手続きの控えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: What procedure is this slip from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の振込です。受取人に送った名前もどう表示されるか、確認できる範囲で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込日時と相手への表示確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yesterday's bank transfer. Within what can be checked, I also want to ask how the name sent to the recipient appears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State when the transfer was made and ask to check the name displayed to the recipient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録と振込表示の相談として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take this as an inquiry about registration and the transfer display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。表示の制限があっても、登録名を自分で短くしてよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示制限で登録名を自己省略しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Even if there are display limits, I will not assume I may shorten the registered name myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that display limits do not mean you may abbreviate the registered name yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料と控えを担当へお見せください。それぞれの表示についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Show your document and slip to the staff member in charge. They will explain each display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り置きのお受取でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you collecting an item put aside for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、待っている間に同じ商品を売場でもかごへ入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約品受取時に同品を売場で取ったと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But while waiting I also put the same item from the sales floor into my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you picked up the same item from the sales floor when collecting your reserved item. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要なのは取り置き分だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you only need the reserved item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。一箱の予定です。売場の一箱も追加したいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要一箱で追加購入でないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I planned to buy one box, not the extra box from the shelf too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you need one box and are not making an additional purchase. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り置きの番号を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your reservation number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号です。予約名と商品が合っていたら、かごの同じ一箱は係の方へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約番号を示し一致後に売場品を戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. Once the reservation name and product match, I will return the identical box in my basket to a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the reservation number and return the shelf item after confirming a match. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り置き分はすでにお支払いされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already paid for the reserved item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。予約しただけで支払済みとは思っていません。今日の会計を一箱でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約のみ未払いで一箱会計を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I do not assume reserving it means I have paid. Please charge me for one box today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it was only reserved and unpaid, and ask to pay for one box. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号と商品が一致しました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。予約分の一箱を受け取り、余分な箱を会計から外したことも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約受取と余分品会計除外を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will collect the reserved box and also check that the extra box has been removed from the bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm collection of the reserved box and removal of the extra item from checkout. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 売場の一箱はお預かりしました。取り置き分一箱の会計をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have taken back the box from the sales floor. We will now arrange payment for the one reserved box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 撮影場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a filming spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の短い動画を撮りたいですが、後ろに子どもたちが写ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 動画背景に子どもが写る問題を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to film a short video of my friend, but children would appear in the background.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about children appearing in the video's background. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人の少ない場所へ移れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can move somewhere with fewer people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 移りたいです。友人だけを撮る予定で、知らない子どもの顔は入れたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人のみの撮影で他人の顔を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to. I only intend to film my friend and do not want unfamiliar children's faces in the shot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only want to film your friend and avoid other people's faces. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この横の広場なら背景を変えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The open area beside us would give you a different background.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 広場へ行きます。ただ、人が来たら一度止めて、通行する人に道を譲ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場へ移り通行人が来たら止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will go there. But if someone comes, I will pause and give way to people passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move to the open area and stop filming when people pass. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使いません。携帯だけで、長い時間同じ場所を占めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯のみで短時間利用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Just my phone. I will avoid occupying the same spot for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will only use a phone and occupy the spot briefly. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮った後の映り込みも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check for people in the footage afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。背景を確認してから友人へ渡します。撮り終わっただけで、すぐ公開はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 背景確認後に共有し即公開しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the background before giving it to my friend. I will not publish it as soon as filming is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the background before sharing, and do not publish immediately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 広場の端をご利用ください。撮影中も周りの方の通行を優先してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Use the edge of the open area. Give priority to other people's passage while filming too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の操作でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗り換え先の駅名が出ません。この機械で買う券ではないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的駅が券売機に出ないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The station where I am heading after changing trains does not appear. Is this not the machine for the ticket I need?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the destination station is missing from the machine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの線へ乗り換えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which line are you changing to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内にある線です。駅が同じなので、どの券売機でも買えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換線を示し同駅なら全機利用可と誤解したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The line in these directions. I thought any machine would sell it because it is the same station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the connecting line and explain your mistaken belief that every machine at the station could be used. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは別の会社の券売機です。乗換え側の窓口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This machine belongs to another company. I will show you the counter for the connecting service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。買えないからといって、似た駅名の券を選ぶのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た駅名を代用しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I will not choose a similar station name just because I cannot buy the right one here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not substitute a similar station name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いま券は購入されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you bought a ticket just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。入力を戻してから、乗換え側へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未購入で入力を戻して移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will cancel the input before going to the connecting service's side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not purchased and will clear the input before moving. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内板の青い矢印に沿ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow the blue arrow on the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い矢印ですね。窓口で行き先を見せ、今の券から必要な追加も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定経路で窓口へ行き所持券と追加を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The blue arrow, right. I will show my destination at the counter and check what additional ticket I need with the one I already have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Follow the specified route to the counter and check your existing ticket and any extra ticket needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。購入済みの券があれば、乗換え先の担当にもお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If you have a ticket already purchased, show it to the connecting service's staff too.
